issues: The cycle counting logic is flawed: it incorrectly adds an extra operation for EVERY cycle detected.
An extra operation is ONLY required for "isolated cycles" (where the cycle components have no nodes outside the cycle pointing into them).

If a cycle has an incoming edge from a node outside the cycle (i.e., at least one node in the cycle has an in-degree > 1), we can merge characters to break the cycle without needing an extra temporary character or extra operation.
The original code overcounts the minimum operations when a component contains both a cycle and an attached tree branch.
